recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow build-scope correction that restores the intended site search entry points without hard-coding release-specific search URLs.
issue_request: FHIR-8151 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request from the 2015May DAF ballot asking to add search capability across the FHIR DSTU and FHIR Continuous build sites, with final comments indicating the work was considered already done.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-8151 was found. The current source already had a build-scope CI search page and navbar integration, but the home page prose and footer still pointed users to search.cfm, which is a stub on build.fhir.org and not found on hl7.org/fhir.
additional_context: The active search page source/search-build.html is present in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml and renders a DuckDuckGo search iframe for the CI build. Jira phrase searches found same-family Published issues FHIR-7712 and FHIR-6849 and Duplicate FHIR-7748, but they were not independently decided in this seed run.
reconciliation: Changed source/index.html and tools/templates/newfooter.html to link to [%search-location%], matching the shared navbar and allowing CI and release builds to resolve to their configured search pages.
source_changes: source/index.html: changed the home page 'search this specification' link from search.cfm to [%search-location%].
tools/templates/newfooter.html: changed the shared footer Search link from the search-footer placeholder that rendered search.cfm to [%search-location%].
